description: Unified remote file and directory operator over SFTP. Actions: 'read' (line-numbered with optional [start, end] range, first 512 KiB), 'write' (atomic replace; creates parent dirs), 'patch' (applies <<<< ==== >>>> search/replace blocks atomically; files up to 512 KiB), 'stat' (file metadata or noise-filtered 2-level directory tree). Atomic replacement creates a new inode (use terminal when hard links or extended ACLs must be preserved).

action.description: File operation: read, write, patch, or stat

content.description: Full file content for write, or <<<< ==== >>>> search/replace blocks for patch

nodeID.description: Target SSH node ID or alias

path.description: Absolute path to the remote file or directory

name: file

blocksApplied.description: Number of search/replace blocks applied by patch

content.description: Line-numbered file content (read) or metadata/directory tree (stat)

fuzzyBlocks.description: Number of patch blocks matched only after ignoring per-line leading/trailing whitespace; review these edits

inPlace.description: True when an existing file was updated in place (non-atomic) to preserve ownership or because the directory/server could not stage a temporary file

isDir.description: True if the path is a directory

lintWarning.description: Syntax check warning if detected after write or patch

totalLines.description: Total number of lines read (only the first 512 KiB when truncated)

truncated.description: True if read stopped at the 512 KiB limit

description: Visual desktop automation (Computer Use) on a remote Linux/FreeBSD/Unix SSH node (X11, or Wayland with ydotool/grim). Uses 0-1000 normalized coordinates and returns a compressed screenshot (longest edge <= 1280px) after every action. Keyboard actions ('type', 'key') are rated Dangerous and require approval under the default policy.

action.description: GUI action: shot, click, double_click, right_click, move, type, key, scroll, or drag

coord.description: Normalized 0-1000 coordinates: [x, y] for click/move/scroll, or [start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y] for drag

display.description: Optional X11 display (e.g. :0, :1); auto-detected when omitted

nodeID.description: Target SSH node ID or alias

text.description: Text to input for type, key combination for key (e.g. ctrl+c, Return), or direction for scroll (up, down, left, right)

name: gui

description: List all available SSH nodes managed by XOps, optionally filtered by tag.

tag.description: Filter nodes by tag. If empty, lists all nodes.

name: nodes

nodes.description: List of available nodes with detailed information

description: Execute a shell command or interact with a persistent PTY session on a managed SSH node. Use session='once' (default) for stateless commands or a custom session name to persist cwd, env, and background processes (idle sessions expire after 30m). A running persistent command must be polled (empty cmd) or interrupted (SIGINT/EOF/SIGTERM/SIGKILL) before the next command.

cmd.description: Shell command to execute, empty to poll incremental output on a persistent session, or SIGINT/EOF/SIGTERM/SIGKILL to signal a persistent session

cwd.description: Optional working directory to switch to before executing cmd

execution.description: Optional execution configuration overriding node/global defaults (once mode only); supports fish, zsh, and csh/tcsh. Unspecified environments are probed when the backend supports discovery; explicit server preserves passthrough.

nodeID.description: Target SSH node ID or alias

session.description: Session mode: 'once' (default, stateless) or a custom session name to persist PTY state (cwd, env, background jobs) in the remote login shell (supports POSIX shells, fish, and csh/tcsh)

sudo.description: Whether to execute the command with sudo privileges (once mode only)

timeout.description: Max seconds to wait before returning output (once: bounded by the server tool timeout; persistent sessions: default 5s, after which the command keeps running and can be polled)

name: terminal

newSession.description: True when a new persistent PTY session was opened (initial call or after a previous session expired/closed)

outcome.description: Execution outcome: not_started, completed, or unknown

planDigest.description: Digest of the executed command plan

signal.description: Termination signal if terminated by signal

status.description: Operation status: success, running, or failed

truncated.description: Whether output exceeded limit or was folded

description: Out-of-band HTTP binary file transfer controller. Actions: 'prepare_push' (prepare single-file upload, returns PUT URL & headers), 'prepare_pull' (prepare single-file download, returns GET URL & headers), 'status' (query transfer state & SHA-256), 'cancel' (request cancellation).

action.description: Transfer action: prepare_push, prepare_pull, status, or cancel

nodeID.description: Managed SSH node ID for prepare_push or prepare_pull

overwrite.description: Explicitly replace an existing ordinary file atomically for prepare_push; new file mode is 0600

remotePath.description: Absolute file path on the SSH target for prepare_push or prepare_pull

requestID.description: Client-generated idempotency key for prepare_push or prepare_pull; keep the same key when retrying preparation

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the client file for prepare_push

size.description: Exact client file size in bytes for prepare_push

transferID.description: Transfer task ID returned by prepare_push or prepare_pull, used by status and cancel

name: transfer
